correctness.rationale: The RESULT fixes positive a,b,c and exact continuous linear spline L2 orthoprojection. Reconstructed the standard hat Gram matrix, alternating-sign inverse, kernel row integral formula and endpoint maximum by absolute-value convexity. Independently computed the rational row formulas and row-dominance identities with SymPy, checked positive-factor differences and both n=3 degenerating meshes, and checked 24 exact sample cellwise integrals. These exact algebraic identities, not finite sampling alone, validate all-positive-three-cell inequalities, strictness, endpoint location and fixed-mesh sign attainment. The values agree with Malyugin 1983 n=3 theorem. No statement for higher spline degree or degenerately zero actual cells is proved.
risks: The numerical checks do not prove universal quantifiers; exact symbolic certificates and structural argument do.

originality.rationale: Decisive direct prior coverage. S. A. Malyugin (1983) already proves the exact L-infinity norm of the orthogonal projector onto continuous linear splines for every knot partition (Theorem 1) and its sharp n-cell extrema (Theorem 2), with the precise 5/3 infimum and 8/3 supremum for n=3. Foucart (2008) explicitly identifies this k=2,m=1 finite-breakpoint case as settled by Malyugin. The submitted work omits that original and presents its n=3 special case as new. A shorter-end algebraic expression does not rescue the original covered final finding as a whole.
